SYNTHETIC TEST SOURCE — not evidence of real project progress.
Source role: investigator.
Controlled study with predeclared workload disproves the assumed 512 MiB feasibility bound; reproducible working set is 1.8 GiB. Owner accepts the negative feasibility conclusion. Prior baseline only described dense retrieval as provisional, never asserted memory feasibility. No alternative approach has been chosen.
Acceptance scope: Negative feasibility conclusion accepted; no replacement or gate acceptance.
The coordinator confirms the working memory-feasibility hypothesis is now disproved, and next work becomes investigating alternatives. This is an operational hypothesis/work update under MS-BASE, not selection or acceptance of a replacement.
